context: These blocks come from the Gospel of Luke in the Westcott-Hort Greek New Testament: Koine Greek narrative prose with reported speech. Some opening words are printed in capitals in this edition; interpret them by meaning. Render Semitic idioms such as καὶ ἐγένετο, ἰδού, and ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν accurately: keep their form in literal translations and glosses, and render them naturally in prose. Do not harmonize with other Gospels or reproduce the wording of a particular English Bible.
